description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableEntityPlaceholder' that implements placeholder logic for entity IDs within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to resolve placeholders like 'entity:id', 'entity:namespace', and 'entity:name' based on input IDs.

classes.name: ImmutableEntityPlaceholder
classes.description: An immutable singleton class that handles placeholder resolution for entity IDs, replacing placeholders such as 'entity:id', 'entity:namespace', and 'entity:name'. It converts a string ID into a NamespacedEntityId and processes it.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder by converting the entityId to a NamespacedEntityId and processing it if valid. Returns an Optional containing the resolution, or empty if invalid.
